summary.headline: Compliance-led accountancy automation still looks like the strongest UK solo-founder wedge, with late-payment automation and narrowly-scoped AI admin services close behind.
summary.best_opportunity: Making Tax Digital workflow automation for small UK accountancy and bookkeeping firms
summary.why_now: Live HMRC and GOV.UK pages fetched this run show MTD for Income Tax starts in April 2026 for qualifying income over £50,000, extends to over £30,000 in April 2027, and to over £20,000 in April 2028. That creates an immediate implementation window for workflow-heavy services that a solo engineer can sell before building a full product.

top_opportunities.name: Making Tax Digital workflow automation for small UK accountancy and bookkeeping firms
top_opportunities.description: Productized implementation service that automates reminders, client document collection, status tracking and quarterly-update readiness around Making Tax Digital for Income Tax.
top_opportunities.why_now: This run fetched an HMRC news page saying MTD for Income Tax starts in April 2026 for sole traders and landlords with qualifying income over £50,000, plus GOV.UK publication pages confirming the £30,000 wave in April 2027 and the £20,000 wave in April 2028.
top_opportunities.buyer: Small accountancy firms, bookkeeping practices and tax-admin operators serving sole traders and landlords
top_opportunities.recurring_revenue: High - setup fees plus monthly support and quarterly workflow retainers
top_opportunities.founder_fit: Excellent for a solo engineer if positioned as workflow implementation and admin reduction rather than tax advice.
risks: Must stay away from regulated tax advice and focus on systems and operations
Accounting software incumbents are entrenched, so the wedge needs to be faster rollout and lower admin burden
top_opportunities.verdict: Best overall because urgency is real, delivery can begin as a service, and retainers are a natural follow-on.

top_opportunities.name: Late-payment and receivables automation for small UK B2B service firms
top_opportunities.description: Productized quote-to-cash workflow that sends reminders, escalates unpaid invoices, updates pipeline status and gives owners a simple cash-collection dashboard.
top_opportunities.why_now: Live GOV.UK and Small Business Commissioner pages fetched this run say late payments affect cash flow, increase costs and make it harder for businesses to invest and grow, with SBC research stating late payments cost the UK economy almost £11 billion per year and contribute to 14,000 business closures annually.
top_opportunities.buyer: Small agencies, consultancies, service businesses and specialist trades with recurring invoicing
top_opportunities.recurring_revenue: High - monthly monitoring, reminder automation and reporting retainers
top_opportunities.founder_fit: Strong for a solo engineer because it can start with email, spreadsheet, accounting-software and CRM integrations rather than a full billing platform.
risks: Some firms see collections as internal cleanup rather than a new budget line
Integrations can sprawl if too many accounting tools are supported too early
top_opportunities.verdict: One of the best fast-cash offers because the ROI story is immediate and measurable.

top_opportunities.name: AI admin automation for professional-service SMEs
top_opportunities.description: Niche automation package for enquiry triage, meeting notes to CRM, proposal drafting, document chasing and follow-up workflows in admin-heavy SMEs.
top_opportunities.why_now: The live GOV.UK AI Adoption Research page fetched this run says the most common AI use areas are marketing (72%), administration (72%) and IT (64%), and 56% of AI-using businesses report increased employee productivity. Buyers already believe the category, but generic positioning is crowded.
top_opportunities.buyer: Recruiters, mortgage brokers, consultancies, agencies and legal-adjacent SMEs
top_opportunities.recurring_revenue: High - implementation projects plus optimisation and support retainers
top_opportunities.founder_fit: Very strong for a solo engineer using existing APIs and workflow tools before building standalone software.
risks: Generic AI automation positioning is crowded unless narrowed to one niche and one KPI
Macro adoption evidence is strong, but close rates will vary sharply by sub-vertical
top_opportunities.verdict: Broad and sellable if framed around one painful admin bottleneck instead of vague AI transformation.

top_opportunities.name: Missed-call text-back and AI receptionist automation for UK local businesses
top_opportunities.description: Simple missed-call recovery system that texts back instantly, captures job details and routes booking requests into a shared inbox or calendar.
top_opportunities.why_now: Live DuckDuckGo result pages and direct vendor pages fetched this run show active UK sellers such as CallAid and Triple J Receptionist already selling missed-call recovery and AI receptionist outcomes. The evidence here is mostly market-signal rather than official data, but it suggests buyers already understand the problem.
top_opportunities.buyer: Trades, clinics, garages, salons and other local operators that regularly miss inbound calls
top_opportunities.recurring_revenue: High - monthly messaging, routing, reporting and support fees
top_opportunities.founder_fit: Excellent for a solo engineer because it can be launched quickly with telephony, SMS and scheduling integrations.
risks: Evidence is weaker than the GOV.UK-backed opportunities and comes mostly from market pages
Local-business pricing can be tight unless sold around recovered bookings
top_opportunities.verdict: Very attractive for first revenue if sold as recovered bookings rather than generic AI.

top_opportunities.name: Client onboarding and AML workflow automation for UK accountancy firms
top_opportunities.description: Service-first onboarding stack for ID capture, reminders, AML steps, approvals and status tracking for smaller accounting practices.
top_opportunities.why_now: This run found active UK category evidence through live search results and direct pages including Firmcheck and Nomi, both focused on AML or onboarding for accountants. That indicates real demand, although the realistic solo-founder angle is implementation and workflow simplification rather than building a full AML platform from scratch.
top_opportunities.buyer: Small accountancy and bookkeeping firms that want faster onboarding without a full software migration
top_opportunities.recurring_revenue: High - setup fees plus monthly support and workflow monitoring
top_opportunities.founder_fit: Strong for a solo engineer comfortable with forms, notifications, secure admin tooling and light integrations.
risks: Sensitive client data raises privacy and reliability expectations
Established software vendors mean the offer must stay narrower and more implementation-led
top_opportunities.verdict: Still strong, especially if bundled as onboarding cleanup plus ongoing admin reduction.

best_pick.name: Making Tax Digital workflow automation for small UK accountancy and bookkeeping firms
best_pick.why_it_wins: It has the clearest live trigger, the shortest path to a paid implementation sprint and obvious recurring support potential. The work is workflow-heavy instead of deep-product-heavy, which suits a part-time solo software engineer much better than launching a broad new SaaS from zero.
validation_plan: Review 20 small UK accountancy firms and note how they currently explain MTD readiness, reminders and quarterly-update workflows.
Build one working demo that automates client reminders, document chasing and status tracking around an MTD workflow.
Pitch a fixed-fee MTD workflow sprint to 30 firms with a promise of fewer manual chases and cleaner quarterly readiness.
Turn the first successful sprint into a monthly support and optimisation retainer.
best_pick.first_offer: MTD workflow sprint: automate one compliance-heavy process in 10 days for a fixed fee, then support it monthly.
best_pick.mvp: A thin internal dashboard with client status, reminders, document collection, exception flags and integrations for email, forms and the firm's existing stack.
best_pick.do_today: Choose small accountancy firms as the first niche, build one MTD reminder and document-chasing demo, and send targeted outreach to 30 UK practices with a fixed-price workflow sprint offer.
